text:
maria_gonzalez: Quick heads-up — ACME & Redwood joint webinar on Tues 9am PT. Need final run-of-show + AV/accessibility + swag locker plan. Who's on for speaker shuffle and remote mic check?
jonah_bennett: I can run the dry-run at 7:30am PT that day. will do remote mic and caption checks.
sasha_liu: I'll own accessibility checklist — captions, live transcript link, alt text for slides, and a quiet-room backup for noisy presenters.
kevin_choi: Partner-side ask: ACME wants a short pre-recorded demo as fallback if remote lab flaps. We should confirm file format + how to hot-swap.
alex_devrel: For hot-swap, prefer a 1080p MP4 <= 1GB. Run a local copy on our encoder VM and have it queued in OBS. Command we'll use: `obs-cli --scene "fallback_demo" --source play`.
partner_ops_bot: :info: Reminder — swag locker cut-off for on-site pick-up is 48h before event. Shipping labels close Friday.
maria_gonzalez: Can partnerships confirm swag SKU list? we need customs-friendly items for EU attendees. No lithium batteries etc.
jonah_bennett: Confirmed SKUs: stickers, T-shirt, USB-C cable (low-power), postcard cheat-sheet. Will remove power banks per customs.
sasha_liu: Accessibility — can presenters provide slide alt-text 24h prior? I'll run an automated scan for contrast issues and send fixes.
kevin_choi: On demo failover: plan A = live SI demo on dedicated GPU pool; plan B = pre-recorded demo; plan C = live recorded screen-share from on-site engineer. Need clear trigger points.
alex_devrel: Suggest triggers: 3 consecutive failed inference calls within 60s -> failover to pre-record. We'll document thresholds in runbook.
maria_gonzalez: Great. Who will be point for on-site swag locker staffing and last-mile? @jonah_bennett?
jonah_bennett: I can staff first hour. need a backup for midday handoff — @kevin_choi can you cover 11:30-1:30?
kevin_choi: Yep. also need pickup ticket scanner app installed on event tablet. Link: https://internal.tools/swag-scanner
partner_ops_bot: :thumbsup: Task created: "Swag locker labeling + customs doc" assigned to jonah_bennett. Due: 48h pre-event.
sasha_liu: Also adding captioning vendor contact: VerbatimLive. I'll share creds in DM.
maria_gonzalez: Final ask — please add speaker accessibility notes to the shared runbook and upload final slides to drive by EOD Monday. I'll compile into a single PDF fallback.
alex_devrel: We'll also record gallery view and presenter feed separately for post-event clips.
kevin_choi: Quick checklist I will upload: AV run-of-show, encoder obs scene names, fallback video filename convention (`partner_acme_fallback_v1.mp4`).
maria_gonzalez: Thanks team. I'll post the consolidated runbook here once done. :rocket:
